proposed.explanation: Postmodern ornament communicates semantic meaning through historical or ironic reference; this approach is functionally justified (thermal performance), not semantically motivated. High-Tech exposes structural and mechanical systems; perforation patterns serving thermal performance are not mechanical systems per se. While the pattern may resemble natural forms, the justification is functional (solar modulation) not biomimetic (organism imitation). The perforation pattern is algorithmically linked to solar data, making it a performance visualization rather than applied ornament. This exemplifies Parametricism's theoretical claim: ornament returns as optimization made visible, not as decoration divorced from function.
